criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Run python -m venv .venv inside a practice project. Record the command, Python version and environment path. Exclude .venv from source control. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

On Windows run .venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)". Record the full output and identify the project environment segment. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Run the environment interpreter with -m pip list. Save output in environment.md; distinguish the standard library from installed third-party distributions. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

For an installed project dependency, record its exact installed version in requirements.txt. If no packages are installed yet, document that and use the bundled standard-library app. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

When online, use python -m pip download -r requirements.txt -d wheelhouse with the intended interpreter/platform. Document that compatible dependency artifacts are required; do not claim a package name is an offline copy. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create .venv-rebuild and, if using dependencies, install with -m pip install --no-index --find-links wheelhouse -r requirements.txt. Show an import and version. Record a missing wheel as a blocker, not success. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Compare sys.executable and -m pip --version for two interpreters. Explain how a package can be installed for one while an import fails in the other; provide the corrected command. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
